source.title: Derry Journal, 1 November 1946, p. 5 ("Nationalist candidate returned"); Londonderry Sentinel, 2 November 1946, p. 5 ("Nationalist returned for Ardmore")
source.publisher: Derry Journal (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: Derry Journal 1 Nov 1946 p5: 'Mr. Wm. DOHERTY (N.) 209, Mrs. Crawford (U.) 172. Of the 397 votes on the register, 13 did not vote. There were three spoiled' (209+172+3 = 384 = 397-13); Londonderry Sentinel 2 Nov 1946 p5 (image): majority of thirty-seven over Miss Nora Ross Crawford (Unionist).

note: Triennial election. The county Londonderry polls were postponed; nominations were taken on 17 October 1946. Only Ardmore was contested (poll Thursday 31 October 1946); the twelve unopposed returns are recorded, including two new members for Middle Liberties and Lough Enagh. Filed on 1946-10-31, the polling day for county council and rural district elections in Co. Londonderry that year (confirmed); previously filed under 1946-10-03 (verification 5 Nov 2026). Doherty was the retiring member. The Journal prints 'Mrs. Crawford', the Sentinel 'Miss Nora Ross Crawford'.
